title: Нагиев решает сделать предложение  (Nagiyev Decides to Propose)

segments.t: Continuing his flashback, Chef Barinov recalls how Nagiyev invited Kristina to a romantic dinner that very evening and asked Vika to have another hostess cover her shift. Pulling out a velvet box in the office, Nagiyev announces to Barinov and Vika that he intends to propose to Kristina tonight.
Дима, ты покажи ей ценник от кольца.
Я не хочу больше покупать женщин.
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
'How about we have dinner tonight?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'what' before landing on 'today'.
'Well, I am actually on shift at work.' The meaning hinges on 'come on' working together with 'work' in spoken Russian. Dmitry answers right away.
'I will arrange it.' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'to agree' in spoken Russian.
'And have someone cover for Kristina this evening.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'both', while 'Kristina' completes the thought.
'Because this is very important to me.' In Russian, the idea of 'but' flows naturally into 'important' without extra filler words. Dmitry answers right away.
'Tonight, never mind why.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'why'.
'I want to propose marriage to her.' The grammar packs 'want' and 'offer' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'You know Kristina, right?' Vika anchors the line on 'you', while 'know' completes the thought. Dmitry answers right away.
'She has a romantic nature.' Dmitry brings out the contrast between 'she' and 'romantic' in a few short words.
Дима, ты покажи ей ценник от кольца.
'Dima, just show her the price tag on the ring.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Dima' before landing on 'ring'.
'That will be the most romantic thing of all.' Notice how Russian expresses 'this' and 'of all' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Dmitry answers right away.
'No, Vitya, no.' Dmitry anchors the line on 'there is no', while 'Vitya' completes the thought.
Я не хочу больше покупать женщин.
'I do not want to buy women anymore.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'I', while 'women' completes the thought. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Дима, ты покажи ей ценник от кольца.
Я не хочу больше покупать женщин.

That wraps up this scene as continuing the flashback, Nagiyev confides in Chef Barinov and Vika that he wants to propose marriage to Kristina that evening with an expensive diamond ring. See you next time!
